question.text: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Gluconic acid can form cyclic (acetal/hemiacetal) structure
Gluconic acid is a dicarboxylic acid
Gluconic acid is a partial oxidation product of glucose

Gluconic acid is obtained by oxidation of glucose with <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>

solution.text: Gluconic acid is obtained by partial oxidation of glucose by tollen’s reagent or fehling solution or Br2/H2O. Gluconic acid can not form hemiacetal or acetal.
